crossRefs.note: The children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels…
Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. They plundered…
The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank from the brook.
So Hazael went to meet him, and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels’ burden…

translations.web: The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth.
translations.bsb: But the earth helped the woman and opened its mouth to swallow up the river that the dragon had poured from his mouth.
translations.kjv: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.
translations.asv: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon cast out of his mouth.
